title: The Runaway Slate
logline: An artisan blacklists an apprentice who fled before completing their seven-year term, and both ask an outsider to retrieve the master's stolen drafting slate.

roles.description: A celebrated precision machinist whose reputation conceals mounting private debts.
An exhausted, talented junior machinist who has drafted uncredited parts for five years.
The master's licensed machine shop and testing berth on the main commercial ring.
A decommissioned orbital forge drifting without primary heat in the outer belt.

public_situation: Work in {system}'s precision machine shops has slowed after an apprentice vanished with their master's proprietary fabrication designs.
private_truth: The master secretly sold the apprentice's patent to a competitor to settle private debts, leaving the student with seven more years of unpaid labor and nothing to show for it.

beats.public_change: The master artisan posts a bounty notice on docking boards for a lost optical drafting slate.

missions.reason: The master needs an independent pilot to collect the spare lockbox keys from a locker before the runaway pawnshop courier picks them up.
missions.private_fact: The master already pocketed the licensing royalty check and is terrified the apprentice will show the original drafts to an adjudicator.

beats.public_change: The apprentice holes up in an abandoned scrap forge and transmits a private hail to incoming pilots.

missions.reason: The apprentice needs emergency thermal coils bought and brought to the unheated forge so they can keep their drafting slate powered through the freeze.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice has proof on the slate that every precision tolerance in the master's signature drive line was drawn in the apprentice's hand.

beats.public_change: The master locks the runaway's guild registry, while the apprentice offers the slate's raw design schematics to whoever helps them clear dock.

missions.reason: The apprentice asks the pilot to carry a sealed formal settlement offer directly to the master's counter before guild enforcers seize the shop.
missions.private_fact: The settlement offer waives all past royalties in exchange for an immediate journeyman release and clean guild papers.

player_choice.prompt: The master offers to pay double if the pilot hands over the slate, while the apprentice begs the pilot to endorse their release.

options.label: Sign as witness on the apprentice's journeyman release
Return the slate to the master for full cash payment
Compel a shared partnership using the disputed designs

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the terms and signs the journeyman release.
resolutions.summary: {role:runaway_apprentice} earns clean papers and takes work on an independent rig, while {role:master_smith} loses exclusive shop prestige.

consequences.public_summary: A hired hauler stood witness so a cheated apprentice could walk away with their own craft.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the slate back to the master.
resolutions.summary: {role:master_smith} recovers the slate, deletes the student's credit, and binds {role:runaway_apprentice} to seven more years of dock labour.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold an apprentice's draft slate back to the guild master who stole it.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces both sides into a shared partnership.
resolutions.summary: {role:master_smith} and {role:runaway_apprentice} reopen the forge under a shared trademark, bitter and dependent on each other.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the delivery or drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: {role:master_smith} levies bailiff warrants on the apprentice's tools, keeping the fabrication monopoly intact.

loose_threads.detail: The apprentice's indenture contract was bought from an offshore lender at double market interest.
The replacement coils carry serial numbers assigned to an engineering bureau that closed twenty years ago.

radio_hooks: Precision machine shops in {system} report supply halts amid trade disputes.
Guild arbitrators in {system} decline jurisdiction on apprentice debt contracts.

voice_direction.master_smith: Speaks with dry patrician authority and avoids discussing workshop accounts. Never raises their voice.
voice_direction.runaway_apprentice: Fast, breathless, constantly reciting technical specs to maintain composure. Avoids naming family.
